A '''Flame-Proof Suit''' was an article of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] readily available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The suits were generally found in large [[City/Legends|cities]] and [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] for sale. Flame-Proff Suits general sold for two hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="SWS" />
